item.title: Trial for Paphos man accused of murdering daughter’s ex-boyfriend begins today
item.description: A 58-year-old man goes on trial today for the premeditated murder of 26-year-old Alexandros Antoniou, who was killed outside a Konia kiosk on 19 November 2025 in an attack captured on CCTV. The trial begins this morning at the Criminal Court sitting in Paphos. The indictment was filed at Paphos District Court on 5 December […]

item.title: Private hospital hit with €30,000 fine for repeatedly dumping insurance claims on HIO
item.description: The Health Insurance Organisation has fined a private hospital €30,000 after it repeatedly failed to submit compensation claims on time, forcing HIO to process the paperwork itself. The hospital has missed the 45-day deadline for entering claims so many times that HIO had to step in and do the work, according to HIO director Constantinos […]

item.title: Asian nations heighten screening after India reports Nipah virus cases
item.description: Thailand and Malaysia have increased airport screening measures following the detection of two Nipah virus cases in India, as health authorities work to contain the rare but deadly infection that kills up to 75% of those infected. The virus, which spreads primarily from fruit bats to humans through contaminated food products, has prompted regional concern […]

item.title: Forestry Department pledges overhaul of forest land leasing after damning audit
item.description: The Department of Forests has pledged to overhaul regulations governing state forest land leasing after an Audit Office report exposed chronic problems dating back to the 1970s. item.title: Five held over Larnaca shooting after gang’s €7,000 extortion demand
item.description: A Larnaca court has remanded five men after a gang demanding €7,000 protection money from a businessman triggered a violent clash that ended with gunfire in the city centre. item.title: Kurds march in Nicosia as parliament prepares to vote on Rojava resolution (photos)
item.description: Kurds in Cyprus gathered in Nicosia along with Cypriots on Thursday carrying flags of greater unified Kurdistan to protest attacks by Damascus regime mercenaries in northeastern Syria. item.title: Kurds in Cyprus protest ongoing attacks against Kurdish people in Rojava
item.description: The Kurdish community in Cyprus staged a protest march in Nicosia over ongoing attacks against the Kurdish people in Syria’s Rojava region on Thursday, January 29, 2026.
